note: 6 squares: Marktplatz, Karlsplatz, Bismarckplatz, Universitätsplatz, Kornmarkt, Anatomiegarten

description: big Christmas market across the old town squares
details:
Heidelberg's Christmas market spreads over six squares of the old town: Marktplatz, Karlsplatz (with the ice rink), Bismarckplatz, Universitätsplatz (with a historic carousel), Kornmarkt (the "Winterwäldchen" with the castle above) and Anatomiegarten. In 2025 it drew more than a million visitors.

Open 23 November to 22 December, Sunday to Friday 11-21, Saturday 11-22; free entry. The city recommends public transport.
